_comment: The resolver's fallback motion set, used when NO on-disk calibration exists. These are the same known-good primitives that geometry.FALLBACK_RESOLVED_CALIBRATION returns; a parity test keeps this file in lockstep with the code. Connectors fall back to repeated fixed pulses (12 left / 12 right) because no turn-angle calibration is present, and ready_for_full_path_following stays false.
